Hip-fired shots become slow traveling projectiles that deal up to <pve 55 /> <pvp [?] /> splash damage in a 3.5 meter radius, down to 0% at the edge of the radius, and apply 5 <solar/>Scorch stacks (10 with <solar/>Ember of Ashes).

Aiming Down Sights shoots hitscan projectiles that deal splash damage in a 3 meter radius.
